verified_recipe_and_execution_findings: V4 fixes the V3 source-root ambiguity: the controller/ledger stay rooted in main while every cache/profile/fit/export child has an absolute worktree Python/script path and explicit worktree PYTHONPATH. The four worktree shared paths currently resolve to the exact main .venv, artifacts, cache, and datasets targets; HEAD and all 32 tracked source plus four environment-file hashes currently match the frozen bundle.

The source recipe remains the eight declared own-checkpoint teachers with coefficients .15, .15, .10, .10, .125, .125, .03125, .03125 (sum .8125). The cache main target is the unnormalized source sum; the family targets are raw equal means in strong/full_finetuned/raw_wmse/samefold_baseline order, with family loss weight .1. Main labels and main teacher blend remain clipped to ±2 under their separate training treatment; official global_wp_clip2_v1 is unchanged.

The pinned trainer output arithmetic is 2 main + 19 structural (12 spread, 3 branch, 4 class) + 2 next-change + 8 family = 31 outputs; default aux-next-k is empty. The 10607 train-seqs argument is a ceiling/required full-index argument, not the observed fitted count. The split-bound fitted counts remain 10,535 train and 1,405 valid, with 468 exposed evaluation groups excluded.

The cache estimate is 11,940 fitting groups × 20,000 rows × 4 bytes × 14 channels = 13,372,800,000 bytes. The pinned builder converts the --min-free-gb and --output-budget-gb values using GiB; the 25-GiB floor plus payload requires 40,216,345,600 free bytes. V4 explicitly marks the earlier 24.2-GB reservation advisory/superseded and still requires live shape/channel/count and disk checks; the builder refuses existing output and partial paths.

Cache is serial CPU, chunk size 2, memmap, zero workers, 6.5-GB reservation and 3,600-second cap. Profile is profile-only at the full B16/chunk-2000 H230 shape, 3 warmup plus 20 timed batches, zero workers, no checkpoint/prediction write, 3 CPU/6.5-GB reservation, 4.3-GB allocator, 5-GB observed-VRAM ceiling and 900-second cap. The pinned trainer does not emit p90, so that statistic remains unavailable unless added by a separate profile receipt.

The two student fits are the fixed GRU256×2 seed-3/seed-4 pair with their own seed-matched initializers, identical two-epoch recipe and fixed zero-based epoch-1 checkpoint, no fit-time evaluation, serial one-GPU execution, and one attempt per seed. Valid exports are fixed to that checkpoint and the expected 1,873-row two-column index, but their current producer hashes must be freshly sealed before later grading.

The current fold0 comparison is exposed development evidence only. This contract does not admit cache, profile, fit, export, grade, or score, and H230 versus E511 C1 is a joint recipe comparison rather than an isolated family-head ablation or public forecast.
